mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility has shifted from negative to positive (t-0w: +7.7%), signaling a sustained behavioral reorientation toward outdoor recreation. This outdoor substitution effect will persist over the next four weeks, crowding out indoor retail-and-recreation visits, producing lower RETAIL_REC.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS crossed from negative to positive at t-0w
failure_condition: PARKS mobility remains below baseline or declines by more than 5 percentage points in any of the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC increases by more than 3 percentage points on average over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility has stabilized near +8% across all four weeks, indicating sustained work-from-home adoption. This persistent remote work regime suppresses commuting-linked retail visits and leisure shopping, keeping RETAIL_REC depressed over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stable at 8-11% across all weeks
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL mobility falls below +5% in any of the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC increases by more than 2 percentage points on average over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility has improved monotonically from -36.6% to -30.4% over four weeks, indicating gradual return of commuting. When TRANSIT crosses above -28% (within 1-2 weeks), commuter-linked retail footfall will accelerate, driving RETAIL_REC higher over the subsequent four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises above -28% in any single week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improving by 6.2 points over four weeks
failure_condition: TRANSIT remains below -28% for all four weeks ahead, or RETAIL_REC declines by more than 2 percentage points on average over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has converged to near-baseline (-0.7%), indicating essential-shopping normalization. Coupled with PARKS turning positive, this signals confidence in public spaces. The joint signal of normalized essential mobility and outdoor recreation confidence will drive discretionary retail visits higher over four weeks.
failure_condition: Either GROCERY_PHARM falls below -2% or PARKS falls below +3% in any of the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC declines by more than 1 percentage point on average over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES has stabilized at -21% (minimal week-on-week change from t-2w to t-0w), indicating a policy-locked remote-work regime. If WORKPLACES remains flat (change < 2 points week-on-week) over the next two weeks, this signals no policy relaxation, and RETAIL_REC will remain suppressed.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES week-on-week change remains below 2 percentage points
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES change from t-2w to t-0w is only -0.9 points
failure_condition: WORKPLACES rises by more than 3 percentage points in any single week over the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC increases by more than 2 percentage points on average over the next 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has improved by 5.4 points over four weeks (-35.3% to -29.9%), showing consistent week-on-week gains. This linear recovery trend will continue at the same rate, producing further gains of 5-6 points over the next four weeks, resulting in higher RETAIL_REC.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 5.4 points over four weeks at ~1.35 points/week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines by more than 1 percentage point in any single week over the next four weeks, or the average weekly gain falls below 0.5 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES are both severely depressed (-30.4% and -21.1% respectively at t-0w). If TRANSIT improves faster than WORKPLACES (TRANSIT gains > 3 points while WORKPLACES gains < 1 point in any single week), this signals selective leisure/tourism mobility without commuting recovery, driving RETAIL_REC higher.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT week-on-week gain exceeds WORKPLACES week-on-week gain by more than 2 percentage points
failure_condition: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES move in lockstep (correlation > 0.8) over the next week, or RETAIL_REC declines by more than 1 percentage point in the following week.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility at +8% combined with PARKS at +7.7% indicates a bifurcated regime: people are staying home but also using outdoor spaces. If this bifurcation persists (RESIDENTIAL stable, PARKS stable or rising), indoor retail will remain suppressed as consumers substitute toward outdoor and home-based activities over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains between +6% and +10% AND PARKS remains above +5%
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL falls below +5% or PARKS falls below +3% in any of the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC increases by more than 3 percentage points on average over the next 28 days.
